entry.title: The wrinkles come back
entry.question: Do your bath wrinkles make a new pattern every time?
entry.answer: Some of the same lines return.
entry.explanation: Researchers photographed fingertips after two water soaks, at least a day apart. Major wrinkles reappeared in similar places and directions, even though the skin had returned to normal between sessions.
entry.qualification: A preliminary 2025 study of just three adults. Some wrinkles differed. It supports recurring patterns, not a perfectly identical map every time.

fragment:
Do your bath wrinkles make a new pattern every time?

You’ve seen your fingers prune. Have you ever looked closely at the lines?

Reveal the discovery

Some of the same lines return.

Researchers photographed fingertips after two water soaks, at least a day apart. Major wrinkles reappeared in similar places and directions, even though the skin had returned to normal between sessions.

A preliminary 2025 study of just three adults. Some wrinkles differed. It supports recurring patterns, not a perfectly identical map every time.

The study behind the wrinkles

Three adults, ages 19–22. Five fingers on each person’s right hand were photographed after two 30-minute water immersions, at least 24 hours apart. Water was held at 40°C. Researchers paired the visible wrinkles and compared their directions.

This was preliminary research. Some lines did not match, and manual pairing can introduce bias. The study did not establish a permanent, unique wrinkle identity or prove the proposed blood-vessel mechanism. Wrinkle measurements are not additional participants.

Methods §§2–3.3 and Figure 3. Published February 13, 2025; exact collection dates unspecified. No derived statistics are displayed. The memory exercise uses an invented diagram, not participant data. It does not test wrinkle recurrence.
